mapper.select: SELECT '000001' AS factoryCode, a.emplyr_id AS id, a.user_nm AS name, a.password AS password, a.ihidnum AS ihidNum, a.email_adres AS email, 'USR' AS userSe, a.orgnzt_id AS orgnztId, a.esntl_id AS uniqId, b.group_id AS groupId, b.group_code AS groupCode, b.group_nm AS groupNm FROM haccp_users a LEFT JOIN haccp_departments b ON a.group_id = b.group_id WHERE a.emplyr_id = #{id} AND a.password = #{password} AND COALESCE(a.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y'
SELECT a.emplyr_id AS id FROM haccp_users a WHERE a.user_nm = #{name} AND a.email_adres = #{email} AND COALESCE(a.use_at, 'Y') = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE haccp_users SET password = #{password}, updated_at = now() WHERE emplyr_id = #{id}
